name: Neumorphism
tagline: Soft plastic, pressed into the page.
what_it_means: Neumorphism (new skeuomorphism) makes elements look extruded from, or pressed into, the background itself. The element shares the background colour and is shaped only by a light shadow on one side and a dark shadow on the other. It feels calm and tactile, but needs care for contrast and accessibility.
signature_moves: Dual shadows: light top-left, dark bottom-right
Soft rounded controls: dials, toggles, sliders
Low contrast; add one accent for accessibility
best_for: Smart-home controls, music players, calculators, widgets
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a smart-home control app screen in Neumorphism style. Background and all elements use the same soft grey (#E0E5EC). Shape everything with dual shadows: -8px -8px 16px #FFFFFF and 8px 8px 16px #A3B1C6. Include: a large circular thermostat dial with an inset track, 4 room toggle cards, a pressed (inset-shadow) active state, a pill slider for lights. Rounded corners 24-32px. Text in dark slate (#4D5B7C), one accent (#6C63FF) for active values to keep contrast accessible. Font: Nunito or Manrope. No borders, no gradients except subtle ones on knobs.
